function!
```{r}
create_dual_temp_diff_plots <- function(
  data,                           
  output_file,                    
  temp_diff_cols,                 
  temp_diff_labels,               
  park_name,                      
  built_up_name = "Built-up Area",
  group_col = "Hour",             
  season_col = "phenophase",      
  season_value = "full canopy",   
  plot_colors = c("lightblue", "lightcoral"),
  box_border_colors = "black",
  grid_color = "gray",
  grid_lty = "dotted",
  grid_lwd = 0.7,
  background_below_zero = rgb(0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
  zero_line_color = "red",
  zero_line_lty = 2,
  y_limits = c(-5, 5),
  x_label = "Hour of Day",
  y_label = NULL,
  add_text_boxes = TRUE,
  use_24h_format = TRUE,          # Display 1–24 but keep data as 0–23
  box_width = 0.6,
  outlier_size = 0.5,
  single_variable = FALSE
) {

  # Default y-axis label
  if (is.null(y_label)) {
    y_label <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " (K)")
  }

  # Input validation
  if (length(temp_diff_cols) != 2) stop("temp_diff_cols must contain exactly 2 names.")
  if (length(temp_diff_labels) != 2) stop("temp_diff_labels must contain exactly 2 labels.")
  if (length(plot_colors) != 2) stop("plot_colors must have exactly 2 colors.")

  if (length(box_border_colors) == 1) {
    box_border_colors <- rep(box_border_colors, 2)
  }

  # Hours always 0–23 in data
  hours <- 0:23

  # Filter by season
  season_data <- data[data[[season_col]] == season_value, ]
  if (nrow(season_data) == 0) stop("No data found for season: ", season_value)

  # Output file
  png(output_file, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", pointsize = 14, res = 600)

  # Layout
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 4, 1))

  box_offset <- box_width * 0.3

  # Empty plot
  plot(1, type = "n",
       xlim = c(-0.5, 23.5),
       ylim = y_limits,
       xlab = x_label,
       ylab = y_label,
       axes = FALSE)
  
  axis(1, at = 0:23,
     labels = if (use_24h_format) 1:24 else 0:23,
     cex.axis = 0.7)   # Reduce font size to fit all labels
  axis(2, at = seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = 1), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8)

  # Background below zero
  rect(par("usr")[1], y_limits[1], par("usr")[2], 0,
       col = background_below_zero, border = NA)

  # Horizontal grid
  abline(h = seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = 0.5),
         col = grid_color, lty = grid_lty, lwd = grid_lwd)

  # Draw boxplots for each hour
  for (h in hours) {

    data1 <- season_data[season_data[[group_col]] == h, temp_diff_cols[1]]
    data1 <- data1[!is.na(data1)]

    if (!single_variable) {
      data2 <- season_data[season_data[[group_col]] == h, temp_diff_cols[2]]
      data2 <- data2[!is.na(data2)]
    } else {
      data2 <- numeric(0)
    }

    if (length(data1) == 0 && length(data2) == 0) next

    pos1 <- h - box_offset
    pos2 <- h + box_offset

    if (length(data1) > 0) {
      boxplot(data1, at = pos1, add = TRUE, axes = FALSE,
              col = plot_colors[1], border = box_border_colors[1],
              boxwex = box_width, outline = TRUE, outcex = outlier_size)
    }

    if (length(data2) > 0) {
      boxplot(data2, at = pos2, add = TRUE, axes = FALSE,
              col = plot_colors[2], border = box_border_colors[2],
              boxwex = box_width, outline = TRUE, outcex = outlier_size)
    }
  }

  # text boxes
  if (add_text_boxes) {
    # Upper box
    label_upper <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " > 0: " * .(built_up_name) * " around park " * .(park_name) * " is warmer.")
    twu <- strwidth(label_upper, cex = 0.9) * 1.2
    thu <- strheight(label_upper, cex = 0.9) * 1.8
    rect(0, y_limits[2] - 0.5 - thu/2, twu, y_limits[2] - 0.5 + thu/2,
         col = "white", border = "black")
    text(twu/2, y_limits[2] - 0.5, label_upper, cex = 0.9)

    # Lower box
    label_lower <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " < 0: Park " * .(park_name) * " is warmer.")
    twl <- strwidth(label_lower, cex = 0.9) * 1.2
    thl <- strheight(label_lower, cex = 0.9) * 1.8
    rect(0, y_limits[1] + 0.5 - thl/2, twl, y_limits[1] + 0.5 + thl/2,
         col = "white", border = "black")
    text(twl/2, y_limits[1] + 0.5, label_lower, cex = 0.9)
  }

  # Zero line
  abline(h = 0, lwd = 1.5, lty = zero_line_lty, col = zero_line_color)

  # Legend
  legend("topright",
         legend = temp_diff_labels,
         fill = plot_colors,
         border = box_border_colors,
         bg = "white",
         cex = 0.9)

  box()
  dev.off()

  cat("Plot saved to:", output_file, "\n")
}
```

SEEP
one boxplot function since SEEP has only one built-up reference site:
```{r}
create_single_temp_diff_plot <- function(
  data,                           
  output_file,                    
  temp_diff_col,                  
  temp_diff_label,               
  park_name,                      
  built_up_name = "Built-up Area",
  group_col = "Hour",             
  season_col = "phenophase",      
  season_value = "full canopy",   
  plot_color = "cornflowerblue",  
  box_border_color = "black",     
  grid_color = "gray",            
  grid_lty = "dotted",            
  grid_lwd = 0.7,                 
  background_below_zero = rgb(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), 
  zero_line_color = "red",        
  zero_line_lty = 2,              
  y_limits = c(-5, 5),            
  x_label = "Hour of Day",        
  y_label = NULL,                 
  add_text_boxes = TRUE,          
  use_24h_format = TRUE,          
  box_width = 0.6,
  outlier_size = 0.5              
) {
  if (is.null(y_label)) y_label <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " (K)")

  hours <- 0:23
  season_data <- data[data[[season_col]] == season_value, ]
  if (nrow(season_data) == 0) stop("No data found for season: ", season_value)

  png(output_file, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", pointsize = 14, res = 600)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 4, 1))

  plot(1, type = "n",
       xlim = c(-0.5, 23.5),
       ylim = y_limits,
       xlab = x_label,
       ylab = y_label,
       axes = FALSE)

  axis(1, at = 0:23,
       labels = if (use_24h_format) 1:24 else 0:23,
       cex.axis = 0.7)
  axis(2, at = seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = 1), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8)

  rect(par("usr")[1], y_limits[1], par("usr")[2], 0,
       col = background_below_zero, border = NA)
  abline(h = seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2], by = 0.5),
         col = grid_color, lty = grid_lty, lwd = grid_lwd)

  # Plot boxplots for each hour
  for (h in hours) {
    hour_data <- season_data[season_data[[group_col]] == h, temp_diff_col]
    hour_data <- hour_data[!is.na(hour_data)]
    if (length(hour_data) == 0) next

    boxplot(hour_data, at = h, add = TRUE, axes = FALSE,
            col = plot_color, border = box_border_color,
            boxwex = box_width, outline = TRUE, outcex = outlier_size)
  }

  # Text boxes
  if (add_text_boxes) {
    label_upper <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " > 0: " * .(built_up_name) * " around park " * .(park_name) * " is warmer.")
    twu <- strwidth(label_upper, cex = 0.9) * 1.2
    thu <- strheight(label_upper, cex = 0.9) * 1.8
    rect(0, y_limits[2] - 0.5 - thu/2, twu, y_limits[2] - 0.5 + thu/2,
         col = "white", border = "black")
    text(twu/2, y_limits[2] - 0.5, label_upper, cex = 0.9)

    label_lower <- bquote(italic(Delta*T) * " < 0: Park " * .(park_name) * " is warmer.")
    twl <- strwidth(label_lower, cex = 0.9) * 1.2
    thl <- strheight(label_lower, cex = 0.9) * 1.8
    rect(0, y_limits[1] + 0.5 - thl/2, twl, y_limits[1] + 0.5 + thl/2,
         col = "white", border = "black")
    text(twl/2, y_limits[1] + 0.5, label_lower, cex = 0.9)
  }

  abline(h = 0, lwd = 1.5, lty = zero_line_lty, col = zero_line_color)

  legend("topright",
         legend = temp_diff_label,
         fill = plot_color,
         border = box_border_color,
         bg = "white",
         cex = 0.9)

  box()
  dev.off()
  cat("Plot saved to:", output_file, "\n")
}
```
